evidence: locked Sept22 full-bird and July head-only images

material_findings.next_test: One connected successor with source-feature diagram and whole-bird neutral/exhibit comparison in15–30minutes, stopping after two actual designs without gain.
material_findings.counterevidence: Retained smooth broad pale crown shell, raised bordering strips, exposed circular optic surround, sparse cheek rods and smooth tall bill remain unlike the connected reference head. This supports the proposed priority, not completion. Source cameras and hidden depth remain estimated.
